description: This file contains benchmark classes for measuring the performance of message dequeuing in an Orleans streaming ADoNet setup, including setup, configuration parameters, and a method to retrieve stream messages in parallel.

classes.name: SqlServerMessageDequeuingBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class that runs message dequeuing performance tests against SQL Server, derived from the abstract MessageDequeuingBenchmark class.

classes.name: MessageDequeuingBenchmark
classes.description: An abstract base class defining configuration parameters, setup procedures, and the benchmarking method for measuring message retrieval performance in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, clears all SQL connection pools.

methods.name: IterationSetup
methods.description: Prepares test data and state before each benchmark iteration, including truncating tables and queuing messages.

methods.name: GetStreamMessages
methods.description: Performs the core benchmarking operation by retrieving stream messages with parallelism, simulating message consumption.
